propositions: The per-extra optionality run consumes 21 concurrent job slots, exceeding the org's GitHub Free limits and causing multi-minute macOS queue waits that inflate run times.
The 5 per-extra matrix cells plus the union cell should collapse into one job that loops over isolated venvs, one per extra.
The isolation set must equal _optional.EXTRAS keys plus mcp, closing a gap where metrics has no per-extra CI while mcp is validated only by its boot check.
A union iteration must install .[agents,eval,tracing] jointly to exercise joint dependency resolution that single-extra installs cannot.
The loop must never source activate and must invoke interpreters and console scripts by absolute venv path to avoid ambient-interpreter and stacked-activation silent passes.
The loop must use an rc accumulator with continue and exit $rc so failures are isolated but still surfaced, and clean-core-wheel must remain byte-identical.
